analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – connects consumers to local beekeepers and offers tangible rewards (honey). Dependent on hive maintenance costs.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – offers a unique connection to local beekeeping, but the subscription model and hive maintenance are not radically different from existing honey providers.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – relies on general claims of pollination benefits and biodiversity.
